panel: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: production cockpit background texture for a desktop flight simulator, landscape 16:9, 2048x1152. Primary request: an original photorealistic F-16C inspired instrument panel photographed straight-on from the seated pilot, very slight natural perspective, NOT a screenshot from any game, no logos. Only the dashboard and both side consoles fill the entire image; no sky, no canopy, no outside view, no pilot. Extremely convincing charcoal painted metal, engraved ivory lettering, glass instrument faces, machined screws, worn rubber button edges and subtle usage scuffs, fine mechanical details and soft daylight from upper left; restrained instrument backlighting. Composition must support live software instruments overlaid afterwards. Left square MFD at x=20%-36%, y=18%-48%, right square MFD at x=64%-80%, y=18%-48%; both display interiors entirely blank near-black glass, precise rectangular interior boundaries. Their physical bezels have small tactile buttons on all four sides. Central ICP keypad assembly at x=43%-57%,y=6%-28%, realistic small buttons. DED rectangular blank glass at x=64%-80%,y=4%-13%. Six smaller circular instrument bezels with blank dark interiors clustered below ICP between x=39%-61%,y=38%-77%; no painted pointers or numerical readings inside these apertures, software will draw them. Fine static console switch plates on lower left and lower right. Left throttle quadrant mount at x=7%-15%,y=62%-92%, slot and base only with NO throttle grip. Right side-stick mount at x=85%-94%,y=62%-94%, base and rubber gaiter only with NO grip; center lower panel has no stick. Dark footwell along bottom center. Do not paint any active readouts, HUD, flight scenery, pointers, colourful generic UI, fake luminous gauge values, rendered labels over MFD screens, or a central stick. Physical lettering can be subtle small realistic markings; no large decorative title. This is a texture atlas style near-frontal functional panel background, high material realism and crisp mechanical detail.
